visual_direction: A three-level relay sculpture moves from an amber ceramic sphere at upper-left, through a jade cube descending into depth, to a final copper triangular prism launched across a lower-right void. Ivory stone, dark steel, and limited brass keep the causal chain legible.

render_scope.camera_grammar: cinematic relay tracking; one continuous three-quarter move

route_and_camera.level_1_sphere: Release [-4.25,-1.25,4.35] onto a 5.0 m C2 banked track descending 1.55 m to cube impact [-1.15,-0.10,2.68]. The sphere diverts into a cork arrest cup after the transfer.
route_and_camera.level_2_cube: Cube begins supported at [-0.78,0.05,2.43]; sphere impulse starts it down an 11 degree rimmed sled to the depthward toggle [1.55,1.22,1.67]. It is caught in a pad immediately beyond the toggle.
route_and_camera.level_3_triangle: The toggle withdraws the spring-arm pin at [1.63,1.30,1.55]. Triangle launch starts [1.75,1.36,1.55], crosses open lower-right space, and enters receiver [5.52,2.99,0.85].

camera.rule: The wide portrait composition shows level 1 and level 2 at the first transfer, then eases laterally before level 3 launch; no cut conceals an impulse, latch, or final landing.

beats.physical_cause: The upper sphere's gravity-acquired rolling momentum contacts the resting cube on its supported sled. The cube's new motion comes from the measured contact impulse; the sphere's outgoing path is arrested visibly in its own cup.
beats.measurement_required: Falsify if the cube moves before sphere contact, the sphere-to-cube separation is nonzero at its claimed impulse, the transfer violates the declared candidate momentum/energy tolerance, or the sphere's catch relies on a speed reset.

beats.physical_cause: The independently travelling cube strikes a finite bistable toggle. Its impulse withdraws the launcher pin, and the already visible torsion spring/arm provides the triangle's launch work and off-centre spin. This is one connected causal release, not simultaneous unrelated animation.
beats.measurement_required: Falsify if the toggle releases without cube contact or below 0.30 N s, if the arm moves before latch withdrawal, if the triangle receives post-separation transform/velocity injection, or if cube capture occurs without real support contact.

beats.physical_cause: The spring-launched triangular prism completes its free airborne diagonal and enters the lower-right V cradle. Angled faces, chute normals, friction, and cork compliance dissipate rather than author a terminal pose.
beats.measurement_required: Falsify if triangle flight is not ballistic between launch and receiver, if its measured rotation is outside 1.0-1.3 turns, if it interpenetrates the cradle, or if it cannot remain supported with linear speed <0.02 m/s and angular speed <0.06 rad/s for 0.75 s.

ending: By 9.70-10.60 s the amber sphere, jade cube, and copper prism occupy three separate visible catches at distinct elevations. The release toggle and launcher are on their mechanically supported post-transfer stops; no hero has been hidden, reset, or left unsupported.
notes: No near-miss is claimed. This is intentionally a three-stage machine, not a flat lineup: the depthward cube leg and lower-right flight gap make the causal relay spatial. Candidate checks must test sphere release disabled, cube-toggle latch locked, triangle launcher disabled, and the complete transfer order as separate negative controls.
